claim: Keep the terra-reference header from your request: Terra's docs say the event it eventually sends to your webhook carries the same terra-reference, which is how you know the transfer completed.
quote: When making a to_webhook=true request, keep track of the value of the terra-reference header. When the event is eventually sent to your webhook, the event's terra-reference will match that of the initial request, allowing you to mark off the data transfer as successfully completed
